subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway run disconnects and recovery cannot establish a terminal result, should `openclaw agent` preserve the current automatic isolated embedded fallback or fail closed by default with an explicit rerun opt-in?
rationale: Both choices are defensible but alter an existing user-visible CLI recovery contract; source-level correctness cannot determine which compatibility tradeoff OpenClaw should ship.

options.title: Preserve automatic isolated fallback
options.body: Recover first, then retain the existing fresh-session embedded fallback when the result remains ambiguous so scripted CLI callers continue receiving a result.

options.title: Fail closed with explicit rerun
options.body: Recover first, then stop with the run id unless the caller explicitly opts into a potentially duplicate embedded rerun.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Use recovery-first/no-rerun for `--deliver` while retaining the isolated fallback for interactive CLI output.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Recover first, then retain the existing fresh-session embedded fallback when the result remains ambiguous so scripted CLI callers continue receiving a result.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged abnormal-close fallback whose compatibility contract this PR changes.
